pages.title: Grit-singers
pages.text:
The Grit-singers named every shard by its echo. Iron is low and patient. Gold barely bothers to answer. Diamond does not answer at all; you find it by the silence around it.

They built the first meshes: not to find ore, but to give it somewhere to land.

pages.title: Stone Strand
pages.text:
*The mesh does not find the ore. The mesh gives the ore somewhere to land.*

Seated. The Grit-singers answer when this Post hums.

pages.title: Their camp
pages.text:
The Grit-singers keep a camp in the March highlands: huts, a fire, a Tribe Hearth, an Earth totem, a banner, four Kin — an Elder, a Drummer, a Hunter and a Weaver — and a braced font and a whole Listening Pit.

Their hearth favours raw ores, grits, Attuned Echo. Their Elder trades Echo Shards for raw ore, Attuned Echo for grit, and the Resonance Mesh. At Voice standing they press the tribe's Mark into your hand. Camps already generated in an old world keep the layout they spawned with.
